# Issue #41: `slugify` produces double hyphens and trailing hyphens

`slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello--world-"` but should return `"hello-world"`.
Also `slugify("--a--b--")` should give `"a-b"`.

Please fix `textkit/slug.py`. Do not change the public signature.

content: Fixed. The regex now collapses runs of non-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen (`+` quantifier), and `strip("-")` removes leading/trailing hyphens. Both issue examples and the test suite pass.

arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in textkit/slug.py by changing the substitution regex from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` (collapsing consecutive non-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen) and adding `.strip("-")` to remove leading/trailing hyphens. The public signature is unchanged; `slugify("Hello,  World!")` now returns `"hello-world"` and `slugify("--a--b--")` returns `"a-b"`, and the existing tests pass.
